newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 7.425 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 7.425 percent at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 77-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 7.425 percent versus 7.313 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 168-day treasury bills was 7.545 percent versus 7.445 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender. Bids totalled NZ$282 million.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 357-day treasury bills was 7.836 percent versus 7.725 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender. Bids totalled NZ$175 million.
